# sopuli target

Inspect the estate.

## sopuli target list

```
sopuli target list [OPTIONS]
```

List the targets the configuration expands to.

A target set is a template that generates targets. This command shows the
targets it generates, so before a rotation you can see how many databases
the rotation will change, without counting rows in a binding table. It
always shows the expanded list, so it has no `--resolved` flag; `config
show` shows the template.

Like the `config` verbs, it opens no connection, so it is safe to run
against a production config from a laptop. It says which targets exist,
not which can be reached. `doctor` connects and answers that.

Options:

- `--select` `K=V[,K=V]` (repeatable): Keep only targets carrying every label given. Repeat for more labels.
- `--target` `NAME` (repeatable): Keep only this target. Repeat to add more.
- `--account` `NAME` (repeatable): Keep only this account, and the targets it lives on. Repeat to add more.
- `--group` `NAME` (repeatable): Keep only targets in this group. Repeat to add more.
- `--application`, `--app` `NAME` (repeatable): Keep only this application entry's accounts. Repeat to add more.

It also takes the [global options](README.md#global-options).
